decidedBy: fr-cnaf wave-1 pf-core lane (model executor; no owner forks required)

norms.bearer: o (Organisme) — holder of the attachment power
norms.goal: permit saisie_action(p) against fraudulent indu debtors
norms.name: SaisieInduFrauduleux (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 553-4 exception: attachment otherwise unavailable for indu becomes available where the indu follows a fraudulent scheme or false declaration. Design choice: liberty, not duty — the body may attach.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window (2021-01-01 onward); L. 553-4 in force on the window.

norms.bearer: o (Organisme) — holder of the attachment power
norms.goal: permit saisie_action(p) for maintenance debts and care/accommodation/education costs
norms.name: SaisieCasLegal (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 553-4 I 1/2: closed list of attachable claims. Outside the list attachment stays unavailable.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 553-4 in force on the window.

norms.goal: maintain prestation_versee(o, p) — benefits owed are paid
norms.name: VerserPrestationsDues (duty)
norms.notes: Core payment duty (L. 511-1 channel): fires where allocataire(p) and organisme_debiteur_pf(o, p) hold. Suspension liberties (control, certificates) carve out non-performance without defeating the duty itself.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 511-1 in force on the window.

norms.goal: maintain information_fournie(o, p) — rights information delivered
norms.name: InformerAllocataires (duty)
norms.notes: L. 583-1 information duty: nature and extent of rights. Provenanced fact information_fournie.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 583-1 in force on the window.

norms.goal: maintain concours_prete(o, p) — assistance in drawing up claims
norms.name: PreterConcoursDemandes (duty)
norms.notes: L. 583-1 assistance duty for establishing claims (demandes).
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 583-1 in force on the window.

norms.bearer: o (Organisme) — holder of the suspension power
norms.goal: permit suspendre_versement_action(o, p) where the allocataire refuses checks
norms.name: SuspendreVersementControle (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 583-3: refusal to undergo controls opens suspension. Liberty, not automatic loss — the body may suspend.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 583-3 in force on the window.

norms.bearer: o (Organisme) — holder of the suspension power
norms.goal: permit suspendre_versement_action(o, p) absent health/schooling certificates
norms.name: SuspendreVersementCertificats (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 552-2: payment conditional on certificates; otherwise suspension. Suspension period set by decree — out of scope (boundary B-PFCORE-DECRET-RENVOIS).
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 552-2 in force on the window.

norms.bearer: i (Personne, intermediary) — addressee of the prohibition
norms.goal: forbear offrir_services_action(i, p) — no paid benefit-procurement services
norms.name: OffrirServicesRemuneres (prohibition)
norms.notes: L. 554-2: offering services for pre-agreed fees to obtain benefits is prohibited. Bearer [REDACTED] intermediary i (not the body) — E1330 pattern.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 554-2 in force on the window.

norms.bearer: j (Juridiction) — holder of the ordering power
norms.goal: permit inserer_jugement_action(j, p) — judgment insertion in newspapers
norms.name: OrdonnerInsertionJugement (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 554-3: on conviction (fraud fine track) the court MAY order insertion at the convicted person's expense. Liberty of the court, not a duty.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 554-3 in force on the window.

norms.goal: maintain frais_mesure_supportes(o, p) — insertion cost borne by the body
norms.name: SupporterFraisMesure (duty)
norms.notes: L. 552-6: cost of the insertion measure falls on the paying body (highest payer where several). Cap 150 EUR modeled on the cost relation.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 552-6 in force on the window.

norms.goal: maintain demandeur_ajpp_informe(o, p) — AEEH/PCH criteria and procedure communicated
norms.name: InformerDemandeurAjpp (duty)
norms.notes: L. 544-10 information duty specific to the AJPP track (AEEH and PCH criteria).
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 544-10 in force on the window.

norms.goal: permit accorder_pret_action(o, p) — improvement loans
norms.name: AccorderPretAmelioration (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 542-9: schemes MAY grant home-improvement loans; conditions and limits by decree — out of scope (boundary B-PFCORE-DECRET-RENVOIS).
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 542-9 in force on the window.

norms.goal: permit aider_recouvrement_action(o, p) — help recovering maintenance claims
norms.name: AiderRecouvrementCreances (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 581-1 habilitation: bodies are empowered (not obliged) to help recover maintenance claims.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 581-1 in force on the window.

norms.bearer: o (Organisme) — body barred from direct action
norms.goal: forbear recouvrement_direct_action(o, p) after prefet referral until notified termination
norms.name: PoursuivreRecouvrementDirect (prohibition)
norms.notes: L. 581-10 intermediation freeze: from prefet referral until notified termination no direct recovery action. Death of either party lifts it (defeater CessationIntermediationDeces).
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 581-10 in force on the window.

norms.goal: permit avance_fonds_sociaux(o, p) — advances from social funds
norms.name: AccorderAvanceFondsSociaux (liberty)
norms.notes: L. 583-2: unambiguously assessable benefits may be advanced within established rights.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 583-2 in force on the window.

norms.beneficiary: p (Personne) — via the fisc as recipient system
norms.goal: maintain ij_maladie_transmises(o, p) — L. 431-1 2 daily allowances transmitted
norms.name: TransmettreIndemnitesJournalieres (duty)
norms.notes: L. 583-4 data-transmission duty under law 78-17 informatics-and-liberties regime (regime itself out of scope).
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 583-4 in force on the window.

norms.beneficiary: p (Personne) — via the fisc as recipient system
norms.goal: maintain contribution_transmise(o, p) — enforceable L. 582-2 contribution transmitted
norms.name: TransmettreContributionFisc (duty)
norms.notes: L. 583-5 data-transmission duty once the contribution has executory force.
norms.windowBasis: D-01 coverage window; L. 583-5 in force on the window.

norms.goal: defeat enfant_ouvre_droit(e) — entitlement removed, not a position
norms.name: ExclusionBeneficiairePersonnel (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 512-1 reservation: a child personally in receipt of benefits does not open entitlement. Scenario expects NEITHER + REQUIRES_JUDGMENT (charge channel is judicial) — no FALSE_ONLY precedent in the corpus.
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat allocataire(p) — status removed, not a position
norms.name: ExclusionDetache (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 513-1 seconded-worker exemption: the first paragraph does not apply.
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat action_prescrite(p) — limitation interrupted, status removed
norms.name: InterruptionProcedure (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 553-1 para. 3: ongoing indu-recovery procedure from the closed list interrupts limitation while the body cannot recover.
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat asf_ouvre_droit(e) — ASF entitlement removed
norms.name: AsfCessationCouple (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 523-2: ASF ends where the lone parent forms a couple / the other parent pays. Scenario expects NEITHER (negation-as-absence).
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat aeeh_ouvre_droit(e) — AEEH entitlement removed
norms.name: AeehExclusionInternat (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 541-1: boarding (internat) exclusion from AEEH.
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat forfait_deces_eligible(p, e) — death lump-sum excluded
norms.name: ForfaitDecesCapitalExclut (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 545-1: death capital paid as such excludes the lump-sum track.
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat intermediation_mise_en_oeuvre(p) — intermediation terminated
norms.name: CessationIntermediationDeces (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 582-1: death of creditor or debtor ends financial intermediation.
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.

norms.goal: defeat titre_executoire_delivre(p) — executory title void
norms.name: NulliteTitreInformationMasquee (defeater)
norms.notes: L. 582-2: title void where the debtor concealed maintenance information; positive conjuncts added for range-restriction (LDC-E4101 pattern).
norms.windowBasis: Defeater without window: acts in the target rule window.
